Error Number: 13805; Error Messages: Failed to delete images already output to VisionDatabase. Timeout error occurred during communication with the FTP server.; Cause: Log in to the FTP server was successful, but the deletion process does not complete within the predetermined time.; Remedy: • Check the connection between the controller and the FTP server. • Make sure the FTP server is operating correctly.
Error Number: 13806; Error Messages: Failed to delete images already output to VisionDatabase. Failed to delete files on the FTP server.; Cause: File deletion could not be completed properly.; Remedy: • Make sure the user account has write privileges on the FTP server. • Check the connection between the controller and the FTP server. • Make sure the FTP server is operating correctly.
Error Number: 13807; Error Messages: Backup of settings to VisionDatabase failed.; Cause: Unable to communicate with the FTP server.; Remedy: • Make sure the user account has write privileges on the FTP server. • Check the connection between the controller and the FTP server. • Make sure the FTP server is operating correctly.
Error Number: 13808; Error Messages: Failed to delete images already output to VisionDatabase. Failed to connect to VisionDataStorage.; Cause: (Only when using the dedicated USB cable) Unable to establish a connection with VisionDataStorage.; Remedy: • Make sure the FTP server on VisionDataStorage is configured and operating correctly. • Make sure the dedicated USBcable is connected to the controller and VisionDataStorage. • Make sure the database software on VisionDataStorage is operating.

Error messages Troubleshooting VisionDatabase

Error Number | Error Messages | Cause | Remedy
13901 | Failed to connect to VisionDataStorage. | The dedicated VisionDataStorage USB cable is not connected. | Correctly connect the controller and the VisionDataStorage with the dedicated USB cable.
 | | Communication cannot be established with VisionDataStorage. | • If the message "VisionDataStorage: Unconnected" is displayed on the controller, wait until the message disappears. • Check whether VisionDataStorage is operating properly on the VisionDataStorage status panel or WebUI.
13902 | Failed to log in to VisionDataStorage. | The VisionDataStorage settings have changed. | Check the VisionDataStorage settings.
13903 | Timeout error occurred during output to VisionDataStorage. | Was able to connect to the VisionDataStorage but the processing does not complete within the specified time. | • Check whether VisionDataStorage is operating properly on the VisionDataStorage status panel or WebUI. • Adjust the timeout settings.
13904 | Failed to output the file to VisionDataStorage. | Was able to connect to the VisionDataStorage but was not able to create the file. | • Check the available disk space on VisionDataStorage. • Correctly connect the controller and the VisionDataStorage with the dedicated USB cable. • Check whether VisionDataStorage is operating properly on the VisionDataStorage status panel or WebUI. • Check that the VisionDataStorage write permissions are set to "everyone".
13905 | The output buffer for VisionDataStorage is full. | The controller output buffer for outputting to the VisionDataStorage is full. | Reduce the amount of data to be output, so that the data for each measurement is output at a slower rate than they are output to VisionDataStorage. Or, extend the time between triggers / processing to allow for data to be output. Note: Results data are not written when the buffer is full.

answer.answer: When an external trigger cannot be input in IV4-G600CA troubleshooting, verify if the Polarity is correctly set. Specifically, check if NPN or PNP is selected, as NPN makes the circuit a non-voltage input circuit and PNP makes it a voltage input circuit.

citations.quote_span: Is the Polarity correctly set?; Cell value: When NPN is selected in the Polarity, the circuit becomes a non-voltage input circuit. When PNP is selected in the Polarity, the circuit becomes a voltage input circuit. Check the cables.
